author: BusinessInsider
title: Apple just introduced new leather sleeves for its MacBook Pro laptops — and they start at $180 (AAPL)
text:
Apple just introduced new leather sleeves for its MacBook Pro laptops — and they start at $180 (AAPL) Posted By: BusinessInsider July 12, 2018 Apple introduced new MacBook Pro models and new leather sleeves to go with them. The new sleeves come in three colors: midnight blue, saddle brown, and black. The sleeves cost $180 for the 13-inch MacBook Pro and $200 for the 15-inch MacBook Pro.
Apple on Thursday introduced new MacBook Pro laptops — and new high-end leather sleeves to go with them.
The new MacBook lineup includes a 13-inch MacBook Pro and a 15-inch MacBook Pro, both with Touch Bar, as well as updates like faster processors, better displays, and “quieter”keyboards.
And for the first time, Apple added leather sleeves for its 13-inch and 15-inch MacBooks.
In the past, Apple has only offered leather sleeves for its smaller 12-inch MacBook. But the new sleeves — which come in midnight blue, saddle brown, and black — have been specially designed for the larger Pro laptops.
The 12-inch sleeves, which come in the new colors, still start at $150, but the new sleeves are a bit pricier: the 13-inch sleeve costs $180, while the 15-inch sleeve costs $200.
